summary.text: Whitney Echenique is the Democratic candidate for the Georgia House of Representatives, District 2, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Steve Tarvin.
A logistics professional and small business owner who lives in Northwest Georgia, she says she is running to focus on practical solutions on healthcare, education and economic opportunity.

paragraphs.text: Echenique earned a bachelor's degree from Austin Peay State University in 2011, and Ballotpedia lists her career experience as working in transportation.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she was raised in a working-class family in rural Tennessee, has lived and worked in South Korea and Sweden, and now lives in Northwest Georgia with her husband and two children.
Echenique described herself in the survey as a working mother, small business owner and logistics professional.
She said her campaign focuses on rising costs for families and seniors, accessible and reliable healthcare, and working across communities to find common ground.
She named healthcare access, education, economic opportunity and environmental issues affecting the region, including water quality, as policy areas she is passionate about.
